text:
riley: Heads-up: nightly DAST flagged a jump to 82 findings on web-internal. Several are marked as unverified because evidence was not attached.
casey: any infra churn overnight? we had a key rotation and some RBAC pruning last sprint.
lee: I rotated some KMS keys for the deploy pipeline and tightened a few service account bindings yesterday evening.
scan-bot: nightly-dast v2.8.0 done. 82 findings (+60). Missing evidence attachments for PRs: [4788,4793]. Upload errors: KMS_UNAUTHENTICATED x2; KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED x1.
irene: KMS_UNAUTHENTICATED usually means the caller couldn't authenticate to KMS; do we have an identity mismatch (workload identity vs service account email)?
casey: logs show the runner attempted decryption with "sa-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" but our rotated key only allows a workload identity pool member.
riley: paste of runner log snippet:
```
2026-04-05T23:02:11Z ERROR evidence_uploader: decrypt error: rpc error: code=Unauthenticated desc="Request had invalid authentication credentials"
processor: artifact upload skipped
```
lee: ah, when I applied the key rotation I replaced a project-level binding with a key-level binding but accidentally used the wrong member identity format. I used "principal://iam.googleapis.com/projects/123/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/pool/subject/service-account:sa-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" instead of the expected "serviceAccount:sa-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com".
scan-bot: KMS audit: DataAccess entries for key "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/dast/cryptoKeys/dast-key" show protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=sa-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com and status.code=16 for Unauthenticated.
irene: Fix path: update IAM binding to include correct principal type for the key-level binding, or add a separate binding for the workload identity pool if that's the intended auth.
casey: quick workaround: re-add project-level role roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to sa-runner for evidence reuploads, then follow-up with narrow key-level binding using the right principal format.
lee: I'll open a small infra PR and include the exact TF stanza. Also will add a commit note about verifying KMS principal format.
riley: also: why didn't alerts pick up the Unauthenticated events? ops-bot alerting only counts KeyAccessCount anomalies and hasn't parsed DataAccess status codes.
irene: we need to extend scan-monitoring to index DataAccess protoPayload.status.code and surface Unauthenticated/PermissionDenied as specific evidence-upload alerts with affected principal and resource.
scan-bot: created INC-7715: "DAST evidence missing after KMS key rotation/principal format mismatch" assigned to eng-security.
lee: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/589 (re-add project-level for quick unblock, follow with key-level correction).
casey: approved and merged at 00:18 UTC. Triggered on-demand DAST rerun.
scan-bot: manual-run nightly-2026-04-06-hotfix-1 started. Evidence upload success: increased. Missing attachments resolved.
riley: postmortem items: 1) add KMS principal format checks to infra PR template 2) add DataAccess status indexing in scan-monitoring 3) preflight impersonation check in GH actions for SA authn 4) update RBAC change playbook to list scanners & DAST runner dependencies.
irene: for preflight impersonation check we can run:
```
gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file=/tmp/key.json && 
gcloud kms keys decrypt --location=global --keyring=dast --key=dast-key \ 
  --ciphertext-file=/tmp/ct --plaintext-file=/tmp/pt \ 
  --impersonate-service-account=sa-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
lee: I'll own the infra follow-up to ensure correct principal format in key-level bindings. Estimated PRs: two (workaround + format fix).
casey: I'll own the monitoring change. Will add Grafana panels and an alert rule for DataAccess.status.code != 0 for KMS keys used by scanners.
riley: assign owners in INC-7715 with due date 2026-04-13.
scan-bot: reactions :eyes: from 4 users, :thumbsup: from 3 users.
